<TITLE>EX-10.12</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.12 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>PLEDGE AGREEMENT </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">PLEDGE
AGREEMENT dated as of October&nbsp;27, 2026 (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), by and between SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC., a Maryland corporation (the &#8220;<U>Pledgor</U>&#8221;) and U.S. BANK TRUST COMPANY, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION
(&#8220;<U>US Bank</U>&#8221;), as collateral agent (in such capacity, the &#8220;<U>Collateral Agent</U>&#8221;), on behalf of the Secured Parties. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, Sagard Private Income Fund SPV I LP, a Delaware limited partnership, as borrower (the &#8220;<U>Borrower</U>&#8221;), Sagard Holdings
Manager (US) LLC, as servicer (the &#8220;<U>Servicer</U>&#8221;), Atlas Securitization Products Administration, L.P., as the administrative agent (in such capacity, the &#8220;<U>Administrative Agent</U>&#8221;), Atlas Securitized Products, L.P.,
as lead arranger, each of the Conduit Lenders and Institutional Lenders from time to time party thereto (the &#8220;<U>Lenders</U>&#8221;), each of the Managing Agents from time to time party thereto, the Collateral Agent, US Bank, as collateral
administrator, and U.S. Bank National Association, as document custodian and as custodian, are parties to that certain Revolving Credit and Security Agreement, dated as of June&nbsp;17, 2026 (as the same may be amended, supplemented, restated or
otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with the terms hereof, the &#8220;<U>Credit Agreement</U>&#8221;). Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings attributed thereto in the Credit Agreement.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, in connection with the Permitted BDC Transfer, pursuant to that certain Partnership Acquisition Agreement, dated as of the date
hereof, by and among Sagard Holdings Investment I LP, as the LP Seller, Sagard Holdings Management Inc., as the GP Seller, and the Pledgor, as the Buyer, the Pledgor has acquired 100% of the Partnership Interests (as defined herein) in the Borrower
from Sagard Holdings Investment I LP. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Lenders have agreed to make certain Advances and other financial accommodations to the
Borrower pursuant to, and subject to the terms and conditions of, the Credit Agreement. The obligation of the Lenders to make Advances and other financial accommodations under the Credit Agreement is conditioned on the execution and delivery by the
Pledgor of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Pledgor acknowledges it will receive substantial benefits from the Advances and other financial
accommodations made available to the Borrower under the Credit Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and mutual
covenants herein contained and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Pledge and Collateral Assignment</U>. As collateral security for the prompt and complete payment, performance and observance of all
present and future Guaranteed Obligations (as hereafter defined) (the &#8220;<U>Secured Obligations</U>&#8221;), the Pledgor hereby pledges and collaterally assigns to the Collateral Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties, and grants to the
Collateral Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties, a lien on and security interest in the collateral of the Pledgor described in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2</U> hereof (collectively, the &#8220;<U>Pledged Collateral</U>&#8221;). </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Description of Pledged Collateral</U>. (a)The Pledged Collateral is described as
follows and on any separate schedules at any time furnished by the Pledgor to the Collateral Agent (which schedules are hereby deemed part of this Agreement): </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) all right, title and interest of the Pledgor, whether now existing or hereafter acquired, in (a)&nbsp;the partnership
interests of the Borrower (such partnership interests, the &#8220;<U>Partnership Interests</U>&#8221; and such partnership, the &#8220;<U>Pledged Partnership</U>&#8221;) as set forth on <U>Schedule I</U> and (b)&nbsp;the Second Amended and Restated
Limited Partnership Agreement of the Borrower, dated as of the date hereof (as the same may be amended, supplemented, restated or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with the terms hereof, the &#8220;<U>LPA</U>&#8221;) under which the
Partnership Interests exist; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) all right, title and interest of the Pledgor in and to all present and future payments,
proceeds, dividends, distributions, instruments, compensation, property, assets, interests and rights in connection with or related to the Partnership Interests or the LPA and all monies due or to become due and payable to the Pledgor in connection
with or related to any of the foregoing or otherwise paid, issued or distributed from time to time in respect of or in exchange therefor, and any certificate, instrument or other document evidencing or representing the same (including, without
limitation, all proceeds of dissolution or liquidation); and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) all proceeds (as defined in the UCC as in effect from
time to time in the State of New York (the &#8220;<U>NY UCC</U>&#8221;)) of every kind and nature, including proceeds of proceeds, of any and all of the foregoing (including, without limitation, proceeds which constitute property of the type
described above and, to the extent not otherwise included, all cash proceeds thereof). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Pledgor and the Borrower each acknowledge
that, in conjunction with the exercise of its remedies following the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the Collateral Agent (acting at the direction of the Administrative Agent) may exercise all rights granted to the
Pledgor under the LPA without the consent of the Pledgor subject to and in accordance with the terms of <U>Sections 7</U> and <U>9</U> hereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Delivery of Certificates, Instruments, Etc.; Pledgor Remains Liable</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Pledgor shall deliver to the Collateral Agent any and all original certificates, instruments and other documents at any time evidencing
or representing the Pledged Collateral to the extent available. Each delivery of Pledged Collateral shall be accompanied by a schedule showing a description of the collateral thereto and then being pledged hereunder, which schedule shall be attached
hereto as <U>Schedule I</U> and made a part hereof. Each schedule so delivered shall supersede any prior schedules so delivered. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The
Pledgor represents and warrants that none of the Partnership Interests constitute a &#8220;security&#8221; within the meaning of the NY UCC and covenants that it will not suffer or permit any Partnership Interest to constitute a
&#8220;security&#8221; within the meaning of the NY UCC. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) Notwithstanding the foregoing, if any of the Partnership Interests at any time
constitutes a &#8220;certificated security&#8221; or &#8220;instrument&#8221; (in each case as defined in the NY UCC), such item shall be in bearer form or, if in registered form, shall be issued in the name of the Collateral Agent or endorsed to
the Collateral Agent or accompanied by undated blank interest powers, note powers, endorsements or other necessary instruments of transfer, registration or assignment, duly executed in blank and in form and substance satisfactory to the Collateral
Agent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) Notwithstanding the foregoing, if any of the Pledged Collateral at any time constitutes &#8220;uncertificated securities&#8221;
within the meaning of the NY UCC, the Pledgor will promptly notify the Collateral Agent and the Borrower thereof and the Pledgor will promptly take and cause to be taken, and will cause the issuer of such uncertificated security to take, all actions
required under Articles 8 and 9 of the NY UCC and any other applicable law, to enable the Collateral Agent to acquire &#8220;control&#8221; (within the meaning of such term under <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;8-106</FONT> (or its
successor provision) of the NY UCC) of such uncertificated securities and as may be otherwise necessary or deemed appropriate by the Administrative Agent to perfect the security interest of the Collateral Agent therein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) Anything herein to the contrary notwithstanding, (i)&nbsp;the Pledgor shall remain liable under the contracts and agreements included in
the Pledged Collateral to the extent set forth therein to perform all of its respective duties and obligations thereunder to the same extent as if this Agreement had not been executed, (ii)&nbsp;the exercise by the Collateral Agent of any of the
rights hereunder shall not release the Pledgor from any of its duties or obligations under the contracts and agreements included in the Pledged Collateral, except to the extent that such duties and obligations may have been terminated by reason of a
sale, transfer or other disposition of such Pledged Collateral as provided in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;13</U> hereof and (iii)&nbsp;the Collateral Agent shall not have any obligation or liability under the contracts and agreements included in
the Pledged Collateral by reason of this Agreement, nor shall the Collateral Agent be obligated to perform any of the obligations or duties of the Pledgor thereunder or to take any action to collect or enforce any claim for payment assigned
hereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <U>Additional Collateral</U>. Subject to <U>Sections 7</U> and <U>8</U> hereof, in case any distribution payable in
additional Pledged Collateral shall be declared with respect to any of the Pledged Collateral, or any fractions thereof shall be issued pursuant to any transaction involving any of the Pledged Collateral, or any interests or obligations shall be
distributed upon or with respect to any of the Pledged Collateral, in each case pursuant to a recapitalization or reclassification of the Partnership Interests, or pursuant to the dissolution, liquidation (in whole or in part), bankruptcy or
reorganization of the Pledged Partnership, or to the merger or consolidation of such entity with or into another entity, the interests or obligations so distributed shall be delivered to the Collateral Agent promptly after receipt thereof, to be
held by the Collateral Agent as additional collateral hereunder subject to the terms of this Agreement, and all of the same shall constitute Pledged Collateral for all purposes hereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Representations, Warranties and Covenants of the Pledgor</U>. The Pledgor hereby represents, warrants and covenants that: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Pledged Collateral</U>. Set forth on <U>Schedule I</U> hereto is a list and description of all of the Pledged Collateral that is true,
complete and accurate as of the date hereof and as of each date such <U>Schedule I</U> is supplemented or otherwise updated pursuant to the terms hereof, and the Pledgor is the sole holder of record and the sole beneficial owner of its Pledged
Collateral free and clear of any Lien thereon, except Permitted Liens. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Chief Executive Office; Records; Etc</U>. As of the date hereof, the address of the
chief executive office and principal place of business of the Pledgor, and the location of the books and records relating to the Pledged Collateral, is 280 Park Avenue, 34th Floor West, New York, NY 10017, and the Pledgor will not change said
address or location, other than in accordance with the provisions of the Facility Documents, or change its name or its jurisdiction of formation or organization, as applicable, unless it has provided the Collateral Agent with 10 days&#8217; (or such
shorter period of time as is consented to by Collateral Agent in its sole discretion) prior written notice and taken all actions that the Administrative Agent may reasonably request and determine to be necessary to protect and perfect the Collateral
Agent&#8217;s perfected security interest in the Pledged Collateral. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Sale or Other Disposition of Pledged Collateral</U>. Except as
otherwise expressly permitted under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8</U> hereof, the Pledgor will not assign (by operation of law or otherwise), sell, lease, transfer, pledge or grant a security interest in or otherwise dispose of or abandon, nor
will it suffer or permit any of the same to occur with respect to, any Pledged Collateral. The inclusion of &#8220;proceeds&#8221; of the Pledged Collateral under the security interest granted herein shall not be deemed a consent by the Collateral
Agent to any sale or other disposition of any Pledged Collateral. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <U>Percentage of Outstanding Equity</U>. The Partnership Interests
constitute, and until the payment in full of the Secured Obligations (other than contingent indemnification and reimbursement obligations which are unknown, unmatured and/or for which no claim giving rise thereto has been asserted) will continue to
constitute, not less than 100% of the Partnership interests of the Pledged Partnership owned by the Pledgor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <U>No Options or Similar
Rights</U>. None of the Partnership Interests or other Pledged Collateral is subject to any options to purchase or similar rights of any Person. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) <U>Required Consents</U>. No consent of any Person and no license, permit, approval or authorization of, exemption by, notice or report to,
or registration, filing (other than the filing of financing statements under the UCC in order to perfect a security interest in that portion of the Pledged Collateral constituting general intangibles) or declaration with any governmental
instrumentality is required in connection with (i)&nbsp;the execution, delivery or performance by, or enforceability against, the Pledgor of this Agreement, (ii)&nbsp;the perfection or maintenance of the security interest created hereby (including
the first priority nature of such security interest) or (iii)&nbsp;the exercise by the Collateral Agent of the voting or other rights provided for in this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) <U>Nature of Security Interest</U>. Upon the filing of appropriate financing statements in the office of the Maryland State Department of
Assessments and Taxation, the Collateral Agent shall have a valid and perfected first priority security interest in such Pledged Collateral in favor of the Collateral Agent, on behalf of the Secured Parties, securing the prompt and complete payment,
performance and observance of the Secured Obligations. The Pledgor authorizes the Collateral Agent and the Administrative Agent (without obligation) to file such financing statements in any filing office the Collateral Agent reasonably determines
appropriate to evidence, perfect, maintain or enforce the Collateral Agent&#8217;s first priority security interest granted herein or otherwise in furtherance of the provisions of this Agreement. Nothing herein shall be construed to imply an
obligation or duty on the Collateral Agent. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <U>No Modification of Certain Agreements</U>. Except in accordance with the terms of the
LPA, the Pledgor will not, without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent (a copy of such consent shall be provided to the Collateral Agent) (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld), modify, amend or alter in any material
respect the terms and conditions of any agreement included in the Pledged Collateral (including, without limitation, the LPA). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i)
<U>Further Assurances</U>. The Pledgor will, at its sole cost and expense, perform all acts and execute all documents necessary or reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent from time to time to evidence, perfect, maintain or enforce the
Collateral Agent&#8217;s first priority security interest granted herein or otherwise in furtherance of the provisions of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <U>Agreement of the Pledged Partnership</U>. The Pledged Partnership hereby acknowledges and agrees (to the extent required by the LPA) to
the pledge by the Pledgor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement of the Partnership Interests and, subject in each case to compliance with the terms of this Agreement, to any transfer of Partnership Interests pursuant to the terms of this Agreement
and, in conjunction with the exercise of the Collateral Agent&#8217;s remedies following the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, to the substitution of the Collateral Agent or its nominee as a substituted limited partner or
general partner, as applicable, of the Pledged Partnership with all the rights, powers and duties of a limited partner or general partner, as applicable, of the Pledged Partnership. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. <U>Voting Rights Prior to an Event of Default</U>. Except as otherwise provided in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9</U> hereof, the Pledgor
shall be entitled to exercise in a manner consistent with the terms of this Agreement and the LPA, the voting, consent and similar rights with respect to the Partnership Interests. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8. <U>Distributions</U>. So long as no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, subject to Section&nbsp;5.02(g) of the Credit
Agreement, the Pledgor shall be entitled to receive, retain for its own account and transfer any and all payments, proceeds, dividends, distributions, monies, compensation, property, assets, instruments or rights paid, issued or distributed from
time to time in respect of the Pledged Collateral free and clear of the liens pursuant to this Agreement. All payments, proceeds, dividends, distributions, monies, property, assets, instruments or rights which are received by the Pledgor in
violation of the preceding sentence shall be forthwith paid over to the Collateral Agent, on behalf of the Secured Parties, in the same form as so received (with any necessary endorsement) and the Pledgor shall provide written notification to the
Administrative Agent of such violation and payment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9. <U>Voting Rights After an Event of Default</U>. Upon the occurrence and during the
continuance of an Event of Default and notice by the Collateral Agent (acting as directed by the Administrative Agent) to the Pledgor (which notice shall not be required in the event of an Event of Default due to an Insolvency Event with respect to
the Pledgor) that all rights of the Pledgor to exercise or refrain from exercising the voting, managerial and other consensual rights which it </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
would otherwise be entitled to exercise pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7</U> hereof shall cease, the Collateral Agent (acting as directed by the Administrative Agent) shall be entitled
to exercise all voting power and other rights, powers and privileges with respect to the Partnership Interests until such applicable Event of Default has been waived in accordance with the Credit Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">10. <U>Application of Cash Received</U>. Any cash received by the Collateral Agent pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement shall be
applied to the payment of the Secured Obligations as provided in Section&nbsp;9.01(a)(iii)(A)-(I) of the Credit Agreement. Nothing contained herein shall be construed as requiring the Collateral Agent to take any action in connection with the sale
or other disposition of any Pledged Collateral at any time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">11. <U>Limited Recourse Guarantee</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Limited Guarantee</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) Subject to clause (c)&nbsp;below, the Pledgor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantees to the Secured Parties and
their respective successors and assigns the prompt payment in full when due (whether at stated maturity, by acceleration or otherwise, including amounts that would become due but for the operation of the automatic stay under the Bankruptcy Code) of
the Obligations (as defined in the Credit Agreement) (the &#8220;<U>Guaranteed Obligations</U>&#8221;). The Pledgor hereby further agrees that if the Borrower shall fail to pay in full when due (whether at stated maturity, by acceleration or
otherwise, including amounts that would become due but for the operation of the automatic stay under the Bankruptcy Code) any of the Obligations strictly in accordance with the terms of any document or agreement evidencing any such Obligations,
including in the amounts, in the currency and at the place expressly agreed to thereunder, irrespective of and without giving effect to any law, order, decree or regulation in effect from time to time of the jurisdiction where the Borrower, the
Pledgor or any other Person obligated on any such Obligations is located, the Pledgor will promptly pay the same, without any demand or notice whatsoever, and that in the case of any extension of time of payment or renewal of any of the Obligations,
the same will be promptly paid in full in cash when due (whether at extended maturity, by acceleration or otherwise) in accordance with the terms of such extension or renewal. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) The guarantee in this Section&nbsp;11 is a continuing guarantee and is a guaranty of payment and not merely of collection,
and shall apply to all Obligations whenever arising. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Obligations Unconditional</U>. Subject to clause (c)&nbsp;below, obligations
of the Pledgor under clause (a)&nbsp;above are primary, absolute and unconditional, irrespective of the value, genuineness, validity, regularity or enforceability of the obligations of the Borrower under the Credit Agreement or any other agreement
or instrument referred to herein or therein, or any substitution, release or exchange of any other guarantee of or security for any of the Obligations, and, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, irrespective of any other circumstance
whatsoever that might otherwise constitute a legal or equitable discharge or defense of a surety or guarantor, it being the intent of this clause (b)&nbsp;that the obligations of the Pledgor hereunder shall be absolute and unconditional, under any
and all circumstances and shall apply to any and all Obligations now existing or in the future arising. Without limiting the foregoing (but subject to Section&nbsp;11(c) below), the Pledgor agrees that: </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <U>Limited Guarantee Absolute</U>. The occurrence of any one or more of
the following shall not affect the enforceability of this Agreement in accordance with its terms or affect, limit, reduce, discharge or terminate the liability of the Pledgor hereunder, or the rights, remedies, powers and privileges of any of the
Secured Parties, under this Agreement: (1)&nbsp;at any time or from time to time, without notice to the Pledgor, the time, place or manner for any performance of or compliance with any of the Obligations shall be amended or extended, or such
performance or compliance shall be waived; (2)&nbsp;any of the acts mentioned in any of the provisions of the Credit Agreement or any other agreement or instrument referred to herein or therein shall be done or omitted; (3)&nbsp;the maturity of any
of the Obligations shall be accelerated, or any of the Obligations shall be modified, supplemented or amended in any respect, or any right under the Credit Agreement or any other agreement or instrument referred to herein or therein shall be waived
or any other guarantee of any of the Obligations or any security therefor shall be released or exchanged in whole or in part or otherwise dealt with; (4)&nbsp;any lien or security interest granted to, or in favor of, any Secured Party as security
for any of the Obligations shall be released or shall fail to be perfected; (5)&nbsp;any application by any of the Secured Parties of the proceeds of any other guaranty of or insurance for any of the Obligations to the payment of any of the
Obligations; (6)&nbsp;any settlement, compromise, release, liquidation or enforcement by any of the Secured Parties of any of the Obligations; (7)&nbsp;the giving by any of the Secured Parties of any consent to the merger or consolidation of
ownership of the Borrower or the sale of substantially all of the assets of, or other restructuring or termination of the corporate existence of, the Borrower or any other Person; (8)&nbsp;any proceeding by any of the Secured Parties against the
Borrower or any other Person or in respect of any collateral for any of the Obligations, or the exercise by any of the Secured Parties of any of their rights, remedies, powers and privileges under the Facility Documents, regardless of whether any of
the Secured Parties shall have proceeded against or exhausted any collateral, right, remedy, power or privilege before proceeding to call upon or otherwise enforce this Agreement; (9)&nbsp;the entering into of any other transaction or business
dealings with the Borrower or any other Person; or (10)&nbsp;any combination of the foregoing. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <U>Waiver of
Defenses</U>. The enforceability of this Agreement and the liability of the Pledgor and the rights, remedies, powers and privileges of the Secured Parties under this Agreement shall not be affected, limited, reduced, discharged or terminated, and
the Pledgor hereby expressly waives to the fullest extent permitted by law any defense now or in the future arising, by reason of: (1)&nbsp;the illegality, invalidity or unenforceability of any of the Obligations, any Facility Document or any other
agreement or instrument whatsoever relating to any of the Obligations; (2)&nbsp;any disability or other defense with respect to any of the Obligations, including the effect of any statute of limitations, that may bar the enforcement thereof or its
obligations relating thereto other than the defense of payment in full of the Obligations; (3)&nbsp;the illegality, invalidity or unenforceability of any other guaranty of or insurance for any of the Obligations or any lack of perfection or
continuing perfection or failure of the priority of any Lien on any collateral for any of the Obligations; (4)&nbsp;the cessation, for any cause whatsoever, of the liability of it or the Borrower with respect to any of the Obligations; (5)&nbsp;any
failure of any of the Secured Parties to marshal assets, to </P>

exhaust any collateral for any of the Obligations, to pursue or exhaust any right, remedy, power or privilege it may have against the Borrower or any other Person, or to take any action
whatsoever to mitigate or reduce its liability under this Agreement, the Secured Parties being under no obligation to take any such action notwithstanding the fact that any of the Obligations may be due and payable and that the Borrower may be in
default of its obligations under any Facility Document; (6)&nbsp;any counterclaim, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">set-off</FONT> or other claim which it or the Borrower has or claims with respect to any of the Obligations or the collateral
therefor; (7)&nbsp;any failure of any of the Secured Parties to file or enforce a claim in any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization or other proceeding with respect to any Person; (8)&nbsp;any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">winding-up</FONT> or adjustment of debts, or appointment of a custodian, liquidator or the like of it, or similar proceedings commenced by or against the Borrower or any other Person, including any discharge of, or bar,
stay or injunction against collecting, any of the Obligations (or any interest on any of the Obligations) in or as a result of any such proceeding; (9)&nbsp;any action taken by any of the Secured Parties that is authorized by this clause (b)&nbsp;or
otherwise in this Agreement or by any other provision of any Facility Document, or any omission to take any such action; or (10)&nbsp;any other circumstance whatsoever that might otherwise constitute a legal or equitable discharge or defense of a
surety or guarantor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) <U>Other Waivers</U>. The Pledgor expressly waives, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for
the benefit of each of the Secured Parties, any right to which it may be entitled: (1)&nbsp;that the assets of the Borrower first be used, depleted and/or applied in satisfaction of the Obligations prior to any amounts being claimed from or paid by
it; and (2)&nbsp;to require that the Borrower be sued and all claims against the Borrower be completed prior to an action or proceeding being initiated against such Pledgor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Limited Recourse</U>. Notwithstanding any other provision hereof, the only remedy that the Collateral Agent shall have against the
Pledgor hereunder in the event of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-payment</FONT> by the Borrower of the Obligations is to realize upon the Pledged Collateral. For greater certainty, it is hereby declared that the Secured Parties shall in no
circumstance have any right of payment from the Pledgor hereunder independent of the foregoing. The foregoing: (i)&nbsp;does not constitute a waiver, release or discharge of the Obligations or any portion thereof, and (ii)&nbsp;does not limit or
restrict the right of the Collateral Agent to name the Pledgor as a defendant in any action, suit for judicial foreclosure or for the exercise of any other remedy under or in connection with this Agreement or any other Facility Document so long as
no judgment in the nature of money or deficiency judgment shall be enforced against the Pledgor out of any of its property, assets or undertaking other than the Pledged Collateral. To the extent the Pledged Collateral is not sufficient to meet the
obligations of the Pledgor in full, after application of the Pledged Collateral in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, the Pledgor shall not have any further obligations hereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">12. <U>Events of Default</U>. Each of the following events shall constitute an &#8220;Event of Default&#8221; under this Agreement: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) the Pledgor fails to observe or perform in any material respect any covenants or agreements set forth in this Agreement, and such failure
continues unremedied for a period of thirty (30)&nbsp;days after a Responsible Officer of the Pledgor acquires knowledge thereof or receives written notice of such failure from the Administrative Agent, the Collateral Agent (at the direction of the
Administrative Agent) or any other Person; or </P>

failure from the Administrative Agent, the Collateral Agent (at the direction of the Administrative Agent) or any other Person; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) the

&#8220;Event of Default&#8221; under and as defined in the Credit Agreement shall have occurred and be continuing, subject to any applicable cure periods. </P>

of the Pledged Collateral, in addition to other rights and remedies provided for herein or otherwise available to it, all the rights and remedies of a secured party under the NY UCC at that time (whether or not applicable to the affected Pledged
Collateral) and may also, without obligation to resort to other security, at any time and from time to time sell or otherwise dispose of the Pledged Collateral in a commercially reasonable manner, all without judicial process or proceedings. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) [Reserved]. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The

discharge of Secured Obligations in lieu of cash payment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) The Collateral Agent (acting at the direction of the Administrative Agent)
or the Administrative Agent shall give the Pledgor at least fifteen (15)&nbsp;days&#8217; prior written notice of the time and place of any public sale and of the time after which any private sale or other disposition is to be made, which notice the
Pledgor agrees is reasonable, all other demands, advertisements and notices being hereby waived. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Collateral Agent (acting at the
direction of the Administrative Agent) and the Administrative Agent shall not be obligated to make any sale of Pledged Collateral if either party shall determine not to do so and shall provide the Pledgor with prompt written notice thereof. The
Collateral Agent (acting at the direction of the Administrative Agent) or the Administrative Agent may (with notice to the Pledgor) adjourn any public or private sale or cause the same to be adjourned from time to time by announcement at the time
and place fixed for sale, and such sale may, without further notice, be made at the time and place to which the same was so adjourned. </P>

negligence or willful misconduct of the Collateral Agent or the Administrative Agent, as applicable, as determined in a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction). </P>

agrees that all claims in respect of such action or proceeding may be heard and determined in such New York State court or, to the extent permitted by law, in such Federal court. The parties hereto hereby irrevocably waive, to the fullest extent
they may effectively do so, the defense of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding. The parties hereto agree that a final judgment in any such action or proceeding shall be conclusive and may be enforced in other

Collateral Agent, as applicable, at its address specified in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;21</U> or at such other address as the Collateral Agent shall have been notified in accordance herewith. Nothing in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;19</U>
shall affect the right of the Pledgor or the Collateral Agent to serve legal process in any other manner permitted by law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)

event occurring in connection therewith. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">20. <U>Admissibility of Agreement</U>. The Pledgor agrees that any copy of this Agreement signed

SHALL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK</B><B>. </B><B>EACH OF THE PARTIES HERETO HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL ACTION OR PROCEEDING RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT

Agreement, the Secured Obligations, any agreement or instrument relating thereto or any instrument or agreement required hereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">29.
